justification: Slice 3 wire-ins: StrataHub supplementary detail on the strata card, bushfire BAL band with RFS/CDC pathway and cross-overlay names, terrain interpretation narratives, NARCLIM projected findings, nearby-DA rows with stated cost, and detected-structure detail on the secondary-dwelling card. All existing service output surfaced through the typed boundary; live smoke proves the Hurstville strata detail (SP91614, 77 lots, apartment, registered 2019-09-25).

pre_impl.existing_data: Every wired value already exists: StrataHub returns registration_date alongside the lot count the brief already fetches; bushfire_prescreen emits the RFS referral and CDC pathway keys under compliance; _build_terrain_interpretation existed unused in the terrain service; query_narclim_summary emits delta_2050/2090 keys; the nearby-DA rows already carry cost_of_development in the stream (proved live: Belmore row at 1,824,903 dollars) and only the display was missing.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Trace-before-fix caught that bushfire cross_overlays is emitted as a LIST of type-keyed dicts while the Slice-0 contract typed it as a dict — validation would have raised on every bushfire-prone lot with overlays and killed the whole stream; four old tests had encoded the wrong dict shape (self-confirming mocks) and were corrected to the real service shape.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new sources: terrain interpretation is computed inside the existing terrain service run (fail-safe so a narrative failure never blanks the metrics); the NARCLIM summary rides on the existing climate fetch with three distinct states (deltas / no grid coverage / lookup failed); the climate golden fixture is now captured through the brief's actual fetch seam instead of the bare to_dict so the contract check exercises what the brief really sees.

functions.name: _fetch_climate_risk
functions.input: coordinates for the per-hazard climate scores plus the NARCLIM projection summary
functions.output: the climate dict with a narclim key — a populated summary, an empty dict for no grid coverage, or None when the lookup failed
functions.if_none: a failed projection lookup becomes an honest manifest gap on the card, never fabricated projections or a silent absence

functions.name: _build_climate_disclosure
functions.input: the climate dict including the narclim summary and the uhi/arr/firms raws
functions.output: ClimateDisclosureProfile with projected_findings rows each carrying model, scenario and timeframe
functions.if_none: non-numeric delta values are skipped rather than rendered; missing narclim adds an UnavailableSource entry naming which state occurred

functions.name: _build_bushfire_detail
functions.input: the raw bushfire prescreen envelope with compliance.cross_overlays as the list the service actually emits
functions.output: BushfireDetail with BAL band, RFS referral flag and triggers, CDC pathway flag and the overlay list
functions.if_none: a null compliance block leaves the pathway fields None and the card hides them (bushfire-prone-only detail)

functions.name: _fetch_strata
functions.input: address and coordinates; cadastre decides strata, StrataHub enriches
functions.output: the strata dict now also carrying registration_date beside lot_total and dwelling_type
functions.if_none: a StrataHub failure never fails the brief — the supplementary fields stay absent and classify_strata falls back exactly as before; routing is untouched by the new fields (pinned by test)

values.if_missing: absent or non-numeric keys produce no ProjectedFinding rows and the manifest records the honest gap state

queries: N/A — no new database queries in this slice; all wiring is over existing fetches

break_it.scenario: A bushfire-prone lot with flood and heritage cross-overlays streams its brief
break_it.what_happens: The old dict-typed contract raised ValidationError inside assembly and the whole stream died with an error event; the list-typed contract parses the real shape and the card names the intersecting layers
break_it.how: cross_overlays retyped to the emitted list shape; test_prone_lot_with_overlay_list_does_not_kill_the_stream uses the exact service shape

break_it.scenario: The NARCLIM dataset is not deployed on the runtime (the current state)
break_it.what_happens: The card shows projected findings absent WITH a manifest entry saying the projection lookup failed or data is not deployed — confirmed on the live smoke — never a fabricated projection and never a silent nothing
break_it.how: three-state narclim handling (populated / empty coverage / None failed); test_narclim_lookup_failure_is_distinct_from_no_coverage

break_it.scenario: NARCLIM emits a junk non-numeric delta for one variable
break_it.what_happens: That row is skipped; the remaining numeric deltas still render with model and timeframe attached
break_it.how: isinstance numeric guard in the projection mapping; test_narclim_junk_delta_is_skipped_not_rendered

break_it.scenario: A future edit makes the StrataHub supplementary fields influence brief-type routing
break_it.what_happens: classify_strata output must be identical with and without dwelling_type/registration_date present — the pin test fails any such change

break_it.scenario: The terrain narrative builder throws on an unusual metrics combination
break_it.what_happens: run_terrain_analysis catches it and returns the metrics without an interpretation — the terrain card still renders slope/aspect/drainage, only the narrative block is absent

post_merge.db_reset: none — no schema or data changes
post_merge.secrets: none touched; env-gated layers (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY) stay gated and render as not-configured
post_merge.other_repo: none — the terrain interpretation sibling and new model fields pass through the Trigger.dev relay transparently
post_merge.manual_verify: after Railway deploys, run the brief for 5/1 Treacy St Hurstville (strata card shows 77 lots, apartment, registered 2019-09-25) and any address with satellite on (terrain card shows the findings narratives — needs the Railway runtime where rasterio exists); if NARCLIM data is added to the image later the projected block lights up with no code change
